original_title: Israel Expands Lebanon Assault With Iran-US Talks in Balance
title: Israel Expands Lebanon Assault With Iran-US Talks in Balance
original_summary: Israel expanded its ground assault in Lebanon with its broadest incursion into the country for a quarter of a century as Hezbollah — Iran’s most powerful regional ally — stepped up attacks on Israel’s north.
